title: GAN-Enhanced Diffusion: Boosting Sample Quality and Diversity
summary: Diffusion models have shown great promise in generating high-quality samples for various data types, but they often struggle with balancing sample fidelity and diversity. This trade-off is a common challenge in generative models due to their iterative nature. In this paper, we propose an enhanced diffusion model that integrates a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) framework to address these challenges.
